Game Overview

Red and Blue Stick Huggy is a two-player game built around guide the adventurous Red and Blue Stick Huggy brothers through challenging levels, collecting essential hands and racing against the clock. Master double jumps and coordinate between characters to reach the black portal. Play solo or with a friend, enjoying unique controls and exciting, diverse levels in a race against time.
